_meta.title: Load Diffusion Model (Qwen-Image-2512-Lightning, 4-step, merged, ComfyUI-scaled-fp8)
_meta.note: FIXED 2026-09-09: previously loaded the base checkpoint (qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors, lightx2v's plain 'scaled' fp8 export) plus a separate LoraLoaderModelOnly node for the Lightning LoRA. That plain '_scaled' file stores its fp8 dequantization factors as per-block '*.weight_scale' tensors in a layout ComfyUI's UNETLoader does not recognize for this architecture — confirmed against this container's own logs: 'unet unexpected: [...hundreds of .weight_scale keys...]', all silently dropped. Without those scales the fp8 weights are used uncalibrated and the model produces pure noise regardless of sampler/cfg/shift — reproduced and root-caused on real hardware, not theoretical. lightx2v also ships qwen_image_2512_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled_comfyui_4steps_v1.0.safetensors — same weights with the base + this exact 4-step Lightning LoRA already merged, in the format their own '_comfyui_' name promises (and that ComfyUI's loader consumes with zero 'unexpected keys' warnings, verified). LoraLoaderModelOnly is gone — the LoRA is baked in.
